selection: Fixed evenly spread and boundary training steps, first/last base and hard-negative positions; no loss, image or score inspection used for selection.
ledger_audit: All64shards perarm, source snapshots/admission/history/checkpoint-state digests, counts and sequential step-wise stream reconstruction.
replay: Render only the48 selected consumed RGB/mask instances perarm using frozen generator, exact recorded codes/seeds and original CUDA/runtime; compare every RGB and mask SHA256. Wait for both training arms and model-owner GPU diagnostics to finish.
scope: Independent data-consumption/source/checkpoint audit plus sampled render replay. Not an optimizer-trajectory replay or a proof of correctness for all images.
